description: Skylar helps sales leaders improve team performance through AI-powered sales practice. You can find and launch realistic roleplay sessions, review coaching progress, and see how your team is developing over time. Inside ChatGPT, Skylar helps you spot where reps need support and choose the right practice to run next.
